## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The sectional-analysis (*kē* 科) volume of the three-text *Fǎhuá jīng kēshí* commentarial complex by [佛閑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%96%91) Fóxián 佛閑 of Pǔdésì 普德寺 in Nánjīng, with re-redaction (*chóngdìng* 重訂) by [智一](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E4%B8%80) Zhìyī 智一. The work is the navigational apparatus to the *Kēshí* main commentary ([KR6d0094](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0094)) and follows the standard Sòng-Yuán-Míng-Qīng editorial pattern of providing structural-outline navigational aids for major commentarial productions.

**Abstract**

The *Kēshí kē* belongs together with the *Kēshí xuántán juànshǒu* ([KR6d0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0092)) as the auxiliary navigational apparatus to the *Kēshí* main commentary ([KR6d0094](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0094)). The dating is securely fixed by Zhìyī's 1705 preface (preserved in [KR6d0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0092)).
